title: User Registration and Account Creation
description: Verify successful account creation with valid details.
testDescription: A new user registers with valid information to create an account.
prerequisites: User must not have an existing account with the same email.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to registration page.
2. Enter valid name, email, and password.
3. Agree to terms and conditions.
4. Click 'Register' button.
expectedResult: User account is created successfully, and a confirmation email is sent.
additionalFields: Boundary Value Analysis for password length, Data integrity checks for PII

title: Product Search and Filtering
description: Verify product search and filtering functionality.
testDescription: A user searches for products using keywords and applies filters.
prerequisites: Products must be available in the database.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the search bar.
2. Enter a product keyword.
3. Apply filters such as category and price range.
4. Click 'Search' button.
expectedResult: Relevant products are displayed according to the search criteria and filters.
additionalFields: Boundary Value Analysis for price range, UI Interactions for filter application

title: Shopping Cart Management
description: Verify adding and removing items from the shopping cart.
testDescription: A user adds products to the cart and removes them as needed.
prerequisites: User must be logged in and products must be available.
stepsToPerform:
1. Select a product.
2. Click 'Add to Cart'.
3. Navigate to the cart.
4. Remove a product from the cart.
expectedResult: Products are added and removed from the cart correctly, and the cart updates accordingly.
additionalFields: State Transition testing for cart state, UI Interactions for add/remove actions

title: Checkout Process and Payment Integration
description: Verify the checkout process and payment gateway integration.
testDescription: A user completes the checkout process and makes a payment.
prerequisites: User must have items in the cart and a valid payment method.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to checkout.
2. Enter shipping details.
3. Select payment method.
4. Confirm and complete payment.
expectedResult: Order is processed successfully, and payment is confirmed.
additionalFields: Integration testing with payment gateways, High-risk edge cases for payment failures

title: Order Confirmation and Receipt Generation
description: Verify order confirmation and receipt generation.
testDescription: A user receives an order confirmation and a receipt after successful payment.
prerequisites: Order must be successfully placed and payment confirmed.
stepsToPerform:
1. Complete the checkout process.
2. Check for order confirmation message.
3. Verify receipt is generated and sent via email.
expectedResult: Order confirmation is displayed, and a receipt is generated and emailed to the user.
additionalFields: Data integrity checks for order details, UI Interactions for confirmation display

title: User Profile Management
description: Verify user can update their profile information.
testDescription: A user updates their profile details such as name, email, and password.
prerequisites: User must be logged in and have an existing profile.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to profile settings.
2. Update name, email, and password fields.
3. Save changes.
expectedResult: Profile information is updated successfully, and a confirmation message is displayed.
additionalFields: Data integrity checks for PII, Boundary Value Analysis for password length

title: Role-based Access Control and Permissions
description: Verify access control based on user roles.
testDescription: Different user roles have specific access permissions to various sections of the application.
prerequisites: User roles must be predefined in the system.
stepsToPerform:
1. Log in as an admin user.
2. Attempt to access admin panel.
3. Log in as a regular user.
4. Attempt to access admin panel.
expectedResult: Admin user can access the admin panel, while regular user is denied access.
additionalFields: Decision Table testing for role-based access, UI Interactions for access denial messages

title: Data Validation and Error Handling
description: Verify data validation and error handling for user inputs.
testDescription: The system validates user inputs and provides appropriate error messages.
prerequisites: User must be on a form requiring input validation.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to a form with input fields.
2. Enter invalid data in required fields.
3. Submit the form.
expectedResult: Error messages are displayed for invalid inputs, guiding the user to correct them.
additionalFields: Data validation for sensitive information, Error message accuracy

title: Integration with External Payment Systems
description: Verify integration with external payment gateways.
testDescription: The system successfully integrates with external payment systems for processing payments.
prerequisites: Payment gateway credentials must be configured.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to checkout.
2. Select an external payment method.
3. Complete the payment process.
expectedResult: Payment is processed through the external gateway, and confirmation is received.
additionalFields: Integration testing with payment gateways, High-risk edge cases for payment failures

title: UI Interactions across all screens and forms
description: Verify UI interactions and responsiveness across different devices.
testDescription: The application UI is responsive and interactive across various devices and screen sizes.
prerequisites: Access to different devices and screen sizes.
stepsToPerform:
1. Access the application on a desktop.
2. Navigate through various screens and forms.
3. Repeat steps on a mobile device.
expectedResult: UI elements are responsive and interactive, providing a consistent user experience across devices.
additionalFields: UI Interactions for responsiveness, Cross-browser compatibility checks

title: Guest Checkout Process
description: Verify the checkout process for a guest user without account creation.
testDescription: A guest user completes the checkout process without creating an account.
prerequisites: Guest checkout option must be enabled.
stepsToPerform:
1. Add products to the cart.
2. Proceed to checkout as a guest.
3. Enter shipping and billing details.
4. Select payment method.
5. Complete the payment.
expectedResult: Order is processed successfully, and a confirmation message is displayed.
additionalFields: Boundary Value Analysis for shipping details, Integration testing with payment gateways

title: Password Recovery Process
description: Verify the password recovery process for users who forgot their password.
testDescription: A user initiates a password recovery process to reset their forgotten password.
prerequisites: User must have an existing account with a registered email.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the login page.
2. Click on 'Forgot Password'.
3. Enter registered email address.
4. Check email for recovery link.
5. Follow the link and reset the password.
expectedResult: User receives a recovery email and successfully resets their password.
additionalFields: Data integrity checks for email handling, UI Interactions for recovery link

title: Product Review Submission
description: Verify the ability for users to submit product reviews.
testDescription: A user submits a review for a purchased product.
prerequisites: User must be logged in and have purchased the product.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the product page.
2. Click on 'Write a Review'.
3. Enter review details and rating.
4. Submit the review.
expectedResult: Review is submitted successfully and appears on the product page.
additionalFields: Data validation for review content, UI Interactions for review submission

title: Wishlist Management
description: Verify adding and removing items from the wishlist.
testDescription: A user adds products to the wishlist and removes them as needed.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to a product page.
2. Click 'Add to Wishlist'.
3. Navigate to the wishlist.
4. Remove a product from the wishlist.
expectedResult: Products are added and removed from the wishlist correctly, and the wishlist updates accordingly.
additionalFields: State Transition testing for wishlist state, UI Interactions for add/remove actions

title: Multi-Currency Support
description: Verify the application supports multiple currencies for international users.
testDescription: A user selects a different currency and completes a purchase.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the currency selection option.
2. Select a different currency.
3. Add products to the cart.
4. Proceed to checkout and complete the payment.
expectedResult: Prices are displayed in the selected currency, and the transaction is completed successfully.
additionalFields: Boundary Value Analysis for currency conversion, UI Interactions for currency selection
